[SWS_DM_CONSTR_02144] Mapping bus types to CPP Implementation data type
for scalar types
⌈
In the case addressed by this spec item, it is only possible to de-
fine the
DiagnosticDataElement
as a scalar or an array (see [TPS_DEXT_01001],
[TPS_DEXT_01002]). The ability to define a Variable-Size Array shall only be used for
the last element of the
DID
.
⌋
